name: Text Decode
description: A case-aware scramble that decodes text left to right on view and hover, with reserved widths so lines never reflow and a brief flash as each letter lands.
usage: import { TextDecode } from "@/components/design-for-ai/text-decode";

props.name: text
props.description: The text. \n makes a hard break; long lines wrap normally. Changing it scrambles the old value into the new one.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Decode once when 30% visible, on pointer enter or keyboard focus (of the nearest link or button), or both.

props.name: speed
props.description: Characters per second for the resolving edge. Long strings are capped at about 1.1s.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: Glyph set. auto keeps case and digits in their own class and leaves punctuation alone; any other string is used as-is.

props.name: flashColor
props.description: Colour of the flash as each character lands.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before the on-view decode, for staggering lines.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Change it to replay the decode.
